title: Scorching medley
content:
# Scorching medley

Type: Food | Internal ID: ScorchingMedley | Source: Cauldron | Usage: Crafting, Eating | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Jotun puffs x3, Onion x3, Fiddlehead x3 | Max Health: 32 | Max Stamina: 95 | Duration: 25m | Healing: 4 hp/tick

# Introduction

Scorching medley is an Ashlands-tier food.

## Recipe

Three Scorching medleys are produced at a level 6 Cauldron with:
• 3 Jotun puffs
• 3 Onion
• 3 Fiddlehead

### Crafting

• Ashlands gourmet bowl

## Notes

• Scorching medley has the second-highest stamina gain in the game at 95, second to Roasted crust pie at 100.
• Scorching medley is very easy to obtain compared to other Ashlands-tier food, producing three per craft and requiring resources the player may already have surplus of and/or materials that are relatively easy to obtain.

Categorias: Food, Cooking recipes
